title: Definition of T-norms and T-conorms on Some Subfamilies of Type-2 Fuzzy Sets
content: In this paper, we obtain new t-norms and t-conorms on some important subfamilies of the set of functions from [0,1] to [0,1]. In particular, we define these new operators on the subsets of the functions that are convex, normal, normal and convex, the functions taking only the values 0 or 1 and its subset of the functions whose support is a finite union of closed intervals. These t-norms and t-conorms are generalized to the type-2 fuzzy sets framework.
